paragraphs: Baker, here's the big idea: Christ is enough. All the fullness of God dwells in Him in bodily form, and Paul says you "have been made complete in Christ" (Colossians 2:9-10). So when somebody shows up with a shiny new philosophy and says you need a little something extra, you can smile and keep walking. Paul doesn't say go find more. He says "continue to walk in Him" (Colossians 2:6).

Now look at where you started. You were dead in your trespasses, and God made you alive with Christ (Colossians 2:13). I don't know about you, but I can't bake my way out of a drawer, and you can't work your way out of dead. You were raised through faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from the dead (Colossians 2:12). That's why the roots go down deep and the thankfulness overflows (Colossians 2:7).

And the bill? Gone! He forgave us all our trespasses, and that debt got nailed to the cross (Colossians 2:13-14). Even the powers and authorities that scare people got disarmed and put on public display, because Christ triumphed over them by the cross (Colossians 2:15). So when your past starts waving that old bill at you, friend, remember it's already canceled. Stand on that today, and let it make you thankful.
